## Problem

What problem does this change solve?

## Scope

What is included and intentionally excluded?

## Architecture

- Which layer owns the change?
- What depends on it?
- What could change later?
- Why is this approach appropriate now?

## Validation

- [ ] Lint
- [ ] Typecheck
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Production build
- [ ] Manual validation when applicable

## Evidence

Screenshots, logs, or test evidence when useful.

## Notes / risks

Trade-offs, follow-ups, or known limitations.
